 How these deals are picked
 These are the tech deals NeighborHaus is tracking on Amazon for Cyber Monday, grouped by category with the deepest discount first. A deal only appears here while its price is below the list price we have on record, and each card shows how long it has been since the price was this low.
 Frequently asked questions
 Are Cyber Monday deals real? Some are and some are not. A list price is sometimes raised before an event so the discount looks larger than it is. Every deal on this page is checked against the price history NeighborHaus has tracked for that product, and each card shows how long it has been since the price was this low.
 Will prices drop further before Christmas? Sometimes. Prices on popular electronics often move again around Cyber Monday and in mid-December, but stock can run out first. Cards marked "Wait" are products whose tracked history suggests a lower price is likely; cards marked "Buy now" are at or near their tracked low.
